editorial:
Imagine a world where family loyalty is everything, but the kids are too reckless for their own good. You get to follow Shek Kin, who plays the boss of a powerful crime family trying to keep things under control. The problem is his sons, who can't stop picking fights with other triad bosses. The vibe is gritty and intense, showing you how a few bad decisions can turn a business deal into a bloody war. It feels like a classic crime saga where the tension just keeps building until someone finally snaps.

You will really enjoy the acting here, especially the way the family dynamics feel real even in a world of crime. The action moves fast, though some parts might feel a bit old-school. If you love old-school gang wars and dramatic betrayals, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a massive showdown between the two rival families. After a trail of drugs and murder, the feud reaches a breaking point where almost no one is safe. The sons finally realize that their greed and anger have destroyed their father's legacy. The movie wraps up with a violent clash that leaves the family broken, proving that the cycle of revenge only leads to total loss for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school triad movies and family dramas.
